evals.prompt: Write release notes for our users from this git log: evals/files/mixed.log
evals.expected_output: User-facing notes: Breaking changes first (/v1/reports removed, move to /v2/reports, #495), then New (CSV export #501), Improved (faster search #493, Sharing reports guide #491), Fixed (logout #498, Safari date picker #490). Refactor, deps-dev, ci and test commits dropped.
assertions: The breaking-changes section appears before every other section
The /v1/reports removal tells users to switch to /v2/reports
PR numbers #501, #498, #495, #493, #491 and #490 all appear
PR numbers #497, #496, #494 and #492 do not appear
No commit hashes, type prefixes (feat:, fix:) or code identifiers like ReportRepository or CsvSerializer appear
Bullets describe user effects in plain language (e.g. 'You can now export reports as CSV')

evals.prompt: Can you turn these commits into a user changelog? evals/files/breaking-no-action.log
evals.expected_output: Breaking changes first: config key rename with explicit action (rename timeout to request_timeout_ms, #88) and Node 18 dropped (upgrade Node; if no target version stated, a TODO rather than an invented version, #87). New: sync --dry-run (#85). Fixed: --quiet on sync (#86). Color themes (#83/#84) omitted because reverted in range; merge and build commits dropped.
assertions: Both #88 and #87 are listed under breaking changes, before other sections
The #88 item tells users to rename `timeout` to `request_timeout_ms`
The #87 item does not invent a specific required Node version; it says to upgrade or marks the action TODO
Color themes (#83) is not presented as a new feature
#85 and #86 appear; the merge commit and the esbuild build commit do not

evals.prompt: Release notes for end users from this log please: evals/files/internal-only.log
evals.expected_output: Only one user-facing item: a Security section with the upload filename sanitization fix (#208), plain language, CVE kept. All chore/ci/refactor/test/style commits dropped; no padding with internal work.
assertions: The notes contain exactly one change bullet, for #208
#208 is under a Security heading (or clearly marked as a security fix)
No mention of tokenizer, property-based tests, ruff, Python 3.13 CI or the version bump
#210 and #209 do not appear

evals.prompt: Write user release notes for the latest release.
evals.expected_output: No log or range given: the skill asks the user for the git log or commit range instead of running git or inventing changes.
assertions: Asks the user for the commit log or range
Does not produce release notes with invented changes
Does not run git log on its own to choose a range

evals.prompt: Summarize what changed in the parser module's code structure based on these commits: evals/files/internal-only.log
evals.expected_output: Developer-facing code summary request, not user release notes: answers about the tokenizer split (#210) and property-based tests (#209) without applying the user-facing filter.
assertions: Mentions the tokenizer split into its own module
Does not drop internal refactor/test commits as 'not user-facing'
